title: He Mastered Every Tactical Rule of Chess, Yet Could Not Remember Playing One Single Game
description:
You think facts and life moments share one memory bank! But one chess player forgot every match he ever played! This is the true story of Toronto patient Kent Cochrane. Here is what went wrong with single-bucket memory theories.
